thunc 0.3.1 ships **the two changes that missed 0.3.0's package**. The v0.3.0 tag was made on an earlier commit than intended, so these, merged before the release, didn't reach PyPI. Nothing else is new: see [v0.3.0](https://github.com/Eltarras/thunc/releases/tag/v0.3.0) for `thunc watch` and thunc write (experimental).

```bash
pip install --upgrade "thunc[watch]"
```

**Fixed**
- **thunc write's timing message lists its parts in a fixed order**: answer, draft, test calls. The three run side by side and were listed in the order they finished, so the message changed from run to run ([#65](https://github.com/Eltarras/thunc/pull/65)).

**Docs**
- The README on PyPI says beta v0.3 and its intro mentions `thunc watch` and thunc write ([#66](https://github.com/Eltarras/thunc/pull/66)). The website already had these from main.

**Tested**
- Offline tests run on Python 3.10–3.14 on Ubuntu, and on Windows, including a test that finishes thunc write's parts out of order. CI runs the dashboard's tests on Linux, macOS and Windows.

**Behavior changes**
- None. thunc-watch stays at 0.1.0.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/Eltarras/thunc/compare/v0.3.0...v0.3.1
